infobox.usage: Unlocks the conference room at the peninsula territory on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Conference room key (Conf.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key that opens the conference room, located somewhere on the Lighthouse peninsula territory.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The conference room can be found on the second floor of the guard building at the lighthouse peninsula territory on Lighthouse. Note: The bridge that leads to the peninsula is guarded by Zryachiy and full of Claymores. To safely pass the bridge, an encoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter is required.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Locked Safe - There is currently no key for it in the game, same applies to the one in the adjoining building
- 1x Drawer
- 1x PC block
- 1x Weapon box (4x4)
- Loose loot (, Electronics, Provisions, Meds, Medical supplies)
- Valuables and Currency on the desk at the back of the office
